gates.name: Run Pester tests
gates.detail: Invoke-Pester -Path tools -Output Detailed -PassThru: Tests Passed: 340, Failed: 2, Skipped: 0, Inconclusive: 0, NotRun: 0. Both failures are tools/Test-DesignState.Tests.ps1: '[-] Test-DesignState against this repository's own tree.S12.5/S25.4: the check reports zero findings against this repository and exits 0' -- Expected $null or empty, because could not evaluate: [TrackerUnavailable] gh missing or unauthenticated; WorkStateDivergence not compared, but got @{Reason=TrackerUnavailable; Detail=gh missing or unauthenticated; WorkStateDivergence not compared}. at tools/Test-DesignState.Tests.ps1:1809. And '[-] Test-DesignState against this repository's own tree.S18.6: EnforcementUnevidenced rejects this repository's own superseded decision once its SupersededBy line is removed, and clears once it is restored' -- Expected 1, but got 2. at tools/Test-DesignState.Tests.ps1:1874. Both trace to the same root cause: gh cannot authenticate in this sandbox (gh auth status: 'The token in GH_TOKEN is invalid'), so Test-DesignState.ps1 always reports the TrackerUnavailable could-not-evaluate entry here, which these two tests assert is absent. Confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to this change by running the identical command against origin/main (56ec4f9) before any edit in this PR: same two failures, same reason. This PR's own CI run on this head SHA (check run 'powershell', https://github.com/The-Running-Dev/SubZeroDev.AgentKit/actions/runs/33718716799/job/100533250182) already completed with conclusion success, which is the authoritative signal that gh authenticates correctly in the real CI runner and these two tests pass there.
